title: Sustainability Report Analysis
description: Structured, source-anchored output of the sustainable-manager Document Analysis / Greenwashing Detection workflow. One object per analyzed report. Feeds report-analysis-template.md (human-readable) and analysis_dashboard.py (comparative dashboard). Anti-fabrication rule: every value in key_metrics MUST carry a page and a verbatim quote; if a figure is not in the document it goes in completeness.missing, never in key_metrics. Schema 1.1 (v2.7.3): 'page' accepts an integer or an array of integers; optional blocks for regulatory context, derived values (analyst calculations, never KPIs) and internal-consistency flags. Schema 1.2 (v2.7.4): optional 'quote_source' (text/image) on KPIs and claims; optional verification.method_type; 'verification.performed' defined (true only after an independent re-reading pass). All 1.0 and 1.1 outputs remain valid.

company.description: Reporting entity legal name (and group/perimeter if relevant).

reporting_period.description: Period the report covers, e.g. 'FY2025 (1 Jan – 31 Dec 2025)'.

source_file.description: Filename or reference of the analyzed document.

pages_read.description: Which pages of the document were actually read, e.g. '1-72 all' or '1-40, 100-120'. Mention the pages read visually (image-only pages, screenshots, scanned letters), e.g. '1-120 text; 2, 116-117 visually'.

analysis_date.description: Date of the analysis (ISO 8601, e.g. '2026-10-02'); the regulatory context is stated as of this date.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema used, e.g. '1.2'.

status.description: Reporting status. 'inspired_by' (e.g. 'ispirato agli ESRS') is NOT compliance — keep the distinction explicit.

standards.description: Declared or recognizable standards: GRI, ESRS, VSME, TNFD, SASB, ISSB, UNI/PdR, etc.

scope_note.description: Regulatory position of the report, e.g. 'voluntary — entity outside post-Omnibus CSRD scope', 'subsidiary included in group consolidated report', 'VSME basis: Recommendation (EU) 2025/1710 (FY2025)'.

type.description: e.g. 'limited assurance, ISAE 3000, SGS Italia', or 'absent'.

key_metrics.description: Quantitative KPIs actually present in the document. For Scope 2 report BOTH market-based and location-based when available (as separate entries).

page.description: Physical page(s) in the file (not the printed page number): an integer, or an array of integers when the item appears on several pages (main page first).

quote.description: Short verbatim quote from the document supporting the value.

quote_source.description: OPTIONAL. Where the quote was read: 'text' (text layer, default) or 'image' (screenshot, map, scanned page: transcribed visually). scripts/quote_check.py reports image-sourced quotes as 'IMAGE — manual check', not as failures.

printed_page.description: OPTIONAL. Printed page number when it differs from the physical page (e.g. spreads with 2 printed pages per sheet).

perimeter.description: OPTIONAL. Perimeter of the figure, e.g. 'legal entity', 'group', 'Italy only'.

missing.description: Expected but absent disclosures (e.g. 'Scope 3', 'external assurance', 'SBTi baseline').

page.description: Physical page(s) in the file (not the printed page number): an integer, or an array of integers when the item appears on several pages (main page first).

quote.description: OPTIONAL. Short verbatim quote of the claim from the document.

quote_source.description: OPTIONAL. Where the quote was read: 'text' (text layer, default) or 'image' (screenshot, map, scanned page: transcribed visually). scripts/quote_check.py reports image-sourced quotes as 'IMAGE — manual check', not as failures.

overall_risk_rule.description: OPTIONAL. Which rule of the Overall Risk Rubric (references/greenwashing-detection.md) triggered overall_risk.

verification.description: OPTIONAL but recommended: record what was actually done. 'performed' is true ONLY after an independent re-reading pass — /adversarial-verify, or a self-check that re-opens every cited page and re-derives every KPI value and claim rating (record findings in 'issues'). Running scripts/quote_check.py alone, with or without a visual look at a few pages, is NOT a verification: record it as performed=false, method_type='automated_quote_check', with the script result in 'summary'. The core skill does not orchestrate multi-agent verification on its own.

performed.description: true only if method_type is 'adversarial_verify' or 'self_check_reopened_pages' (see the block description); false for none or an automated quote check only.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the verified analysis.

hallucinations.description: Count of cited values/pages that do not exist in the document.

method.description: OPTIONAL. Free-text description, e.g. 'adversarial-verify (2 lenses)', 'automated quote check only (quote_check.py: 58/58)' — do not present a quote check as an adversarial verification.

method_type.description: OPTIONAL. Controlled value for 'method'. performed=true requires 'self_check_reopened_pages' or 'adversarial_verify'.

regulatory_context.description: OPTIONAL. Acts relevant to the entity as of analysis_date (template §5).

status.description: Legal status/dates, e.g. 'in force 18/3/2026; transposition by 19/3/2027'.

applicability.description: e.g. 'out of scope (686 employees)', 'applies from FY2027', 'possible — verify CN codes'.

source.description: Skill reference or primary source used.

derived_values.description: OPTIONAL. Values computed by the analyst (totals, % changes, ratios). Never KPIs: they are not in the document.

data_quality_flags.description: OPTIONAL. Internal inconsistencies found in the document (sums that do not add up, figures differing between sections).
